inventive_nucleus: A thin layer of electrospun nanofibers with antimicrobial peptides is embedded into the Dacron graft surface to provide a physical barrier against bacterial colonization.
structure: The device consists of a Dacron graft with an embedded layer of electrospun nanofibers and antimicrobial peptides.
control_logic: Embedding the nanofibers into the graft surface
interaction: The nanofibers interact with the bacterial cells on the graft surface, preventing colonization.
operating_condition: The device operates under normal physiological conditions.
failure_containment: The device is designed to prevent bacterial colonization, reducing the risk of graft infection.
expected_effect: Reduced bacterial colonization rates compared to the current device.

interaction: The biosensor interacts with the bacterial cells on the graft surface, detecting their presence and releasing targeted antimicrobial agents.
operating_condition: The device operates under normal physiological conditions.
failure_containment: The device is designed to prevent bacterial colonization, reducing the risk of graft infection.
expected_effect: Reduced bacterial colonization rates compared to the current device.

interaction: The temperature-sensitive graft interacts with the bacterial cells on the graft surface, reducing adhesion.
